added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_WhackAMole_HowToPlay
added.value: Type the words that appear on the incoming enemies to defeat them before they attack Hoodwink!

added.name: DOTA_DarkCarnival_WhackAMole_Scoring
added.value:
Type the incoming words correctly to score points. Score more points for longer words.

Each word completed increases the score multiplier - but beware that failing even a single word will reset the multiplier back to 1.

Spaces and punctuation can be skipped when typing.
